haiku.problem: The wrong answer "A temple" is a near-match for "Father's house" in John 14:2, so a baker could argue it is right. This breaks the no-near-matches rule.

"Ask in what?" is a fragment that doesn't read as a clear question on its own, so it fails the make-sense-at-random rule. "His presence" also appears in John 14:3 ("into My presence"), so it is not clearly false anywhere in the passage. The question is also a less central point than the "seen Me, seen the Father" teaching in 14:9, which has no trivia question.
